purpose: Bind production activation to independently read-back deployment evidence, passing external acceptance, durable release provenance, and observable service heartbeats.
invariants: Deploy acknowledgement alone cannot activate a production release.
Production activation requires DeploymentResult state PROMOTED with deployment evidence.
Production activation requires AcceptanceRun PASS with at least one passing external_system or production assurance result.
Exactly one release is ACTIVE per environment; a newer activation supersedes the prior active release.
Service heartbeat records require explicit revision, state, timestamp, instance identity, and evidence reference.
This repository contract does not claim that any deployment platform, multi-node service, or production environment is actually deployed.
